title: Otoya rework
text: Otoya was announced as Legendary with a new base and awakening kit, a bundle, limited shop items and codes.

title: Karasu rework
text: Karasu was announced as Mythic. The base and awakening kits were revised; Extraordinary Striker Pass and the new chemical reaction were still pending.

title: Zantetsu release
text: Legendary Zantetsu arrived with a secret awakening. Five Halloween limited styles returned.

title: Selfish Captain sound fix
text: Raised the sound level of Selfish Captain in new servers.

title: Aiku polish and quality of life
text: Serpent Wall returned to C; Selfish Captain was added; Venom Clearance and Crushing Bloom effects were corrected. NEL Aiku–Sae chemistry was announced as live.

title: NEL Aiku release
text: NEL Aiku arrived as an evolution style with a defensive base and awakening kit. Selfish Captain was still being revised at release.

title: Sendou release
text: Epic Sendou arrived. Zombie Dribble cooldown changed from 50s to 40s; Undead Step-Pass range +7%, dash distance −5%; Golden Defense cooldown set to 30s. Snuffy gained the Rational Defense on-ball variant.

title: Don Lorenzo revamp
text: New kit and goalkeeper-box awakening variant. A Ubers interaction rewards three or four distinct listed styles in the opponent half; new and revised jerseys were announced.

title: Snuffy release
text: Master Snuffy arrived with defensive and tactical abilities, special animations and Rebellion chemistry with Barou.

title: September quality of life
text: Watchtower added to Niko. Barou received aim and dribble adjustments; Loki and Lavinho were balanced. One goal counted as 1 MVP point and one save as 0.75. Per-style awakening outfits and party improvements arrived; summer map removed.

title: Niko release
text: Niko arrived with defensive skills and Tactical One-Two. Watchtower was still pending in this announcement and added on September 19.

title: NEL King release
text: NEL Barou arrived with Lion Shot, Stealth Kill Shot, Chop Feint, Tyrant Twisted Path, Predator Eye and awakening moves.

title: Additional awakening bars
text: New awakening bars announced for six styles.

title: Big Bang Drive effects
text: Impact frames added to Big Bang Drive.

title: Rin improvements
text: Added missing base sound effects and removed the flow requirement from Center of Gravity. Awakening effects and You'll Never Surpass Me revised.

title: NEL 2.5 and style balance
text: Rarity groups revised; NEL contracts of 5–15 games and team ladder quests introduced. Extensive ability balancing and cutscene outfit fixes.

title: Rin awakening fixes
text: Center of Gravity became available with awakening and flow active at the time; Two Steps Behind added a shot cutscene for the receiver. The flow requirement was later removed.

title: U20 Rin rework
text: New base moves and awakening changes with revised VFX and animations; some awakening features were still pending.

title: Sae improvements
text: New V variant, Magical Turn returned, Divine Pass can trigger chemistry with Shidou. Perfection Shot gained 20% range and speed; i-frames added to Perfection Shot and Divine Pass.

title: Sae revamp
text: New base and awakening abilities and an aerial awakening variant. Ness–Kaiser reworked chemistry reported live.

title: Ness rework
text: Revised kit and animations. Ness–Kaiser chemistry described as upcoming; later announced live on August 15.

title: Ego Coin rewards
text: Ego Coin rewards changed to 4 for MVP, 3 for a win and 1 for playing a match in new servers.

title: World Tournament final
text: Spain and Brazil reached the final; daily, match-mode and main standings and team hubs were announced.

title: Kaiser–Kiyora chemistry
text: New Isagi Final Shot cutscene and My Finest Clown MVP. Borderline to Kaiser can trigger the Kaiser Magnus chemistry after the pass connects.

title: World Tournament quarterfinals
text: Quarterfinals began, with one nation per player, rewards for team victories and nation quests.

title: Dragon Drive and overtime awakening
text: Added aerial C-key Dragon Drive to NEL Shidou and custom awakening bars. Overtime grants awakening to one random player on each team.

title: July quality of life
text: New awakening bars, titles and Bachira MVP.

title: NEL Shidou–Charles chemistry
text: Sky Arc Pass highlights Dragon Header before the ball arrives; activating it triggers the chemistry. Shidou's effects and shot/dribble balance were adjusted.

title: Sae–Shidou chemistry polish
text: Sae's Perfect Pass to Shidou highlights Demon Drive as the ball approaches. Tournament scoreboard resets fixed.

title: NEL Shidou release
text: New NEL evolution quest and moveset, new Mythic Shidou cutscene move and World Tournament part two.

title: Awakening and performance fixes
text: Awakening bars draining during cutscenes fixed across many styles; major crash and lag fixes announced for new servers.

title: World Tournament and summer update
text: U20 World Tournament introduced group and knockout stages, nation representation, daily rewards and a summer map.

title: Gagamaru polish
text: Awakening voice, audio and lighting revised; save pop-up and cosmetic issues fixed.

title: Gagamaru rework
text: Revised kit and secret version of Super-Reflexes.

title: Anti-cheat and performance hotfix
text: Fixed goalkeeper dive and Nagi Trap Shot teleport-back across modes; optimized loading screen and addressed FPS drops/crashes.

title: NEL academy guidance
text: Academy role suitability listed: Arsenaly and Re Al for midfield, Manshine City all positions, Barcha dribblers, Ubers defenders, PXG offense and Bastard Munchen strikers.

title: NEL 2.0
text: New academy and position selection, career stat tiers, team offers and repeatable quests. Goals, steals, assists and saves drive ranking rather than passes.

title: Kiyora release
text: Legendary Kiyora arrived with Backspin Accelerating Shot, Twister Pass and Borderline.

title: NEL Rin and Hiori balance
text: Rin Annihilate speed and power +5%; Hiori Cold Logic Turn became a full dribble, Link Pass range 95m and Below Zero Pass range +20% to 130m.

title: NEL Isagi–Hiori chemistry
text: Hiori's Hard Freeze Counter-Attack to NEL Isagi highlights Direct Shot after the cutscene; using it triggers chemistry.

title: Ice flow rework
text: New Ice VFX and revised bonuses: 7% speed; pass receivers get 15% flow and a short speed boost; small auto-track.

title: NEL Hiori rework
text: NEL Hiori received a revised kit; chemistry with NEL Isagi was described and released June 7. Heel Flick returned to Magical Turn.

title: June balance pass
text: Reo's copied shots received cooldown and power nerfs; many other styles and flows changed.

title: Mini update and private server settings
text: Old moves and sound effects returned; infinite stamina and infinite flow settings were added to PS+, alongside an option to hide other players' cosmetics.

title: Master Of All Trades changes
text: Master Of All Trades became World Class and received a revised set of bonuses; Reo gained two awakening cutscenes.

title: NEL Reo return and rework
text: NEL Reo returned with striker and defensive kits that change with field side, plus separate awakening kits.

title: Flow balance and fixes
text: Numerous flow buffs and nerfs. Magician Flow moved to Legendary; Emperor cooldown reduction changed from 33% to 20%. Infinite Awakening added to PS+.

title: Original map and quality of life
text: Original map revamped; Sae secret awakening and MVP previews added. Yukimiya restored to Mythic and Gyro Shot returned to B.

title: Mobile controls and fixes
text: Movable mobile buttons and new loading screen; shot and steal-cutscene bug fixes. King moved to Legendary; Yukimiya temporarily moved to Legendary before the May 23 reversal.

title: Rarity changes
text: Gagamaru changed to Rare, Karasu Epic and Ness Legendary at that date; later announcements supersede some of these tiers.

title: Kunigami rework
text: Power Shot, Crushing Header and Body Block plus new awakening abilities.

title: May cutscene and skill fixes
text: Fixed Panther Shot direction, infinite Center of Gravity, MetaBurst steal animation, ball visibility and awakening cooldown reset bugs.

title: Kaiser stun restored
text: Emperor's Route stun restored and Subjugation usability fixed.

title: NEL Chigiri evolution
text: New NEL kit and secret awakening with stated 5% odds at release, plus two MVP cutscenes.

title: Otoya and game fixes
text: Dynamo Pass range +20%; Sneaky Volley speed and distance −20%; Kablamo gained i-frames. Similar ball-ring colors prevented on opposing teams.

title: May Otoya rework
text: Earlier Otoya kit rework and selectable MVP packs. Superseded by November rework.

title: NEL system and quality of life
text: New Neo Egoist League system and quality-of-life changes announced.

title: NEL Isagi rework
text: Reworked NEL Isagi kit and shop reward system.

title: Nagi movement and trap changes
text: Dash and Trap Shot endlag removed; simultaneous dash/trap shot and jumping mid-dash restored; I Am Nagi distance nerfed.

title: Nagi and NEL Nagi rework
text: Base Nagi awakening and NEL Nagi kit reworked, including Skull Trap to Breakdance Shot.

title: Limited inventory fixes
text: Added limited rarity and flow section; corrected Easter inventory placement.

title: Spin system reverted
text: Earlier same-day style spin-system change reverted; bugs fixed.

title: Easter update
text: Easter event, quests and Easter Yukimiya announced.

title: Egoist Ranked League
text: New ranked game mode announced.

title: NEL battlepass
text: NEL battlepass and crate announced.

title: Karasu awakening changes
text: Crow Clearance returned to awakening and Raven Awaken gained metavision buffs; VFX polished.

title: March Karasu rework
text: Earlier Karasu rework, balancing and subtitle polish.

title: Nagi and Isagi evolution
text: NEL questlines and wheel introduced; Generational rarity removed, with Generational styles moved to World Class at the time.

title: 3v3 update
text: New three-versus-three game mode announced.

title: Raichi release
text: Raichi added; mobile Fast Mode, private-server ability hitbox display and mobile/console PS+ commands menu introduced.

title: Valentine season pass
text: Valentine season pass and bug fixes.

title: Rin return
text: Rin returned in an earlier update, before the August U20 rework.

title: AFK World and Ness flow
text: AFK World and Yen packs revised; Ness flow announced.

title: Ness release
text: Ness update announced, before the August rework.

title: Kurona rework
text: One-Two gained a return-pass interaction and 10–15% shot buff for the final receiver for 10s; Shark-Steal improved and Bait Dribble added.

title: New Year quality of life
text: Chemical reaction time 160 → 180 (unit unspecified), Santa Lavinho steal nerfed.

title: Firework Bachira release
text: Firework Bachira limited style announced.

title: Firework event
text: Ego Quest and 2026 firework show announced.

title: Santa Lavinho release
text: Santa Lavinho limited style announced.

title: Gingerbread Charles and Subzero Loki
text: Two winter limited styles announced.

title: Krampus Barou release
text: Krampus Barou limited style announced.

title: Reo copy and mastery toggles
text: Reo Copy re-enabled and buffed. NEL mastery toggles and Bachira–Lavinho chemistry announced, with kit variant uncertain in source.

title: Elf Emperor release
text: Elf Emperor Kaiser limited style announced.

title: Bachira and NEL Bachira rework
text: Both kits revised, NEL questline system and NEL Bachira–Lavinho chemistry announced.

title: Twitch and Thanksgiving update
text: Thanksgiving battlepass and crate with Twitch drop announcement.

title: Aiku rework
text: Earlier Aiku rework and limited items.

title: Skeleton Nagi release
text: Skeleton Nagi limited style announced.

title: Bloodmoon Rin and Phantom Isagi
text: Two Halloween limited styles announced.

title: Rebalance bug fixes
text: Fixed a wide range of ability bugs including full-field Street Sweep, Bloodlust, NEL Isagi–Kaiser chemistry cooldown and awakening interactions.

title: Great rebalancing
text: Ball Trajectory Metavision for all goalkeepers, Loki and Nagi. Loki base/passive overhaul; extensive style cooldown and range changes, removals and vaulting.

title: NEL Nagi passive removed
text: NEL Nagi's passive was announced removed.

title: Isagi Lefty Shot removed
text: Lefty Shot removed and Direct Shot restored as an on-ball move at this date.

title: October mini-patch
text: Cutscene, inventory, battle pass, performance and awakening follow-up fixes. Rivalry chemistry softlock addressed.

title: Demon Shidou release
text: Demon Shidou limited style released.

title: Reaper Sae and Halloween
text: Reaper Sae and Halloween update; Demon Shidou was scheduled separately.

title: Don Lorenzo rework
text: Earlier Don Lorenzo rework introduced Zombie Steal and Death Of a Striker, new effects and a secret awakening.

title: Rivals chemical reaction and Demon King
text: Rivals chemistry at defending kickoff when both centre forwards use NEL Isagi and NEL Rin; World Class Demon King flow introduced.

title: Prodigies versus Talented Learners
text: NEL Rin and NEL Isagi were reworked for the event.

title: Nagi, Loki and Lavinho balance
text: Detailed nerfs and removals for Nagi and McNagi, Loki aerial trap removal, Lavinho balance and flow adjustments.

title: September rebalancing
text: Broad rebalance and Sae crates announced.

title: Lavinho release
text: Lavinho style introduced.

title: Bunny release
text: Bunny Iglesias style introduced.

title: Yukimiya rework
text: Yukimiya reworked.

title: 8v8 mode
text: Eight-versus-eight game mode introduced.

title: Charles release
text: Charles released at World Class with Contrarian flow and Charles–Loki chemistry.

title: Sae kit changes
text: Metavision became a passive; Creative Dash replaced V, Divine Destruction limited to near penalty area and Off Balance adjusted. Older kit snapshot.

title: Shidou and Sae refresh
text: Sae and Shidou refresh announced.

title: Chemical reaction system
text: Receiver can request a chemical reaction; a button appears to initiate it.

title: Hiori changes
text: Hiori changed to Rare at the time, Frostbite removed and Ice Dribble restored.

title: McNagi update
text: New McNagi skin, awakening cutscene and move effects announced.

title: NEL Nagi and Singularity
text: NEL Nagi World Class at release, with volley and ball-control passives. Singularity flow introduced and other styles adjusted.

title: Ball physics and style balance
text: Ball physics made independent of FPS; King, Isagi, Yukimiya and flow balances announced.

title: Summer part one
text: Two new maps including Waterpark announced.

title: Reo and flow rework
text: Reo reworked to analyse and copy allies and enemies; associated flow rework.

title: King and flow rework
text: King and its associated flow reworked.

title: Loki and Godspeed
text: New Master style and flow rarities, Loki, Godspeed and exclusive velocity passive introduced.

title: Ranked mode
text: New 4v4 ranked mode with divisions and leaderboard.

title: Aiku rework and AFK World
text: Aiku and flow reworked; AFK World refresh and balance changes announced.

title: Hiori and showroom refresh
text: Hiori refresh, new lobby and showroom NPC.

title: Ego's Summer Strike
text: Limited 4v4 tournament with strike system and goalkeeper locked. Earlier Hiori–NEL Isagi chemistry announced.

title: Performance patch
text: Optimizations across PC, mobile, Xbox and PS5; crash rates and missing textures addressed.

title: NEL Rin and flow rework
text: NEL Rin changed from Mythic to World Class at that date, with style and flow rework.

title: Otoya refresh and AFK World
text: Otoya refresh, chemistry and AFK World update.

title: NEL Bachira update
text: NEL Bachira update announced.

title: April bug patch
text: Fixed shooting after rejoining a match following a heel flick and addressed Sae–Shidou chemistry.

title: Easter event
text: Easter update announced.

title: Igaguri and Buddha's Blessing
text: Igaguri and Buddha's Blessing introduced as Epic at release; ground and aerial Malicia and awakening skills documented.

title: Golden Defense and Lefty Shoot
text: Golden Defense changed to no teammate pass and ignore i-frames; Lefty Shoot delay fixed.

title: Goal Rush Duos and King
text: Goal Rush Duos and King update announced.

title: Kaiser release
text: Kaiser update introduced the Emperor-inspired style.

title: Kurona patch
text: Revised Kurona update addressing issues with the original rollout.

title: NEL Isagi update
text: NEL Isagi introduced with Direct Shot and Lefty Shoot among its abilities.

title: World Class Sae
text: Sae received a new World Class kit, including Metavision.

title: Gagamaru fixes
text: Diving Header restricted to cases where a header is possible; Handstand fixed in new servers.

title: Gagamaru and Chigiri revamp
text: Gagamaru gained Bear Claw awakening; Handstand and Diving Header merged at that date. Chigiri also revamped.

title: Don Lorenzo introduction
text: World Class Don Lorenzo and lucky-spin odds changes announced.

title: Big Bang Drive and Isagi changes
text: Big Bang Drive required an airborne ball; Isagi second ability reworked and Direct Pass removed at this date. Sae awakening and flows revamped.

title: Slide rework reverted
text: Slide rework reverted; flow locking and focus added. Heel flick became character-based again.

title: Slide rework and chemistry
text: Sae–Shidou chemistry and slide rework, private server spectating and anti-cheat changes.

title: Kunigami and Private Server Plus
text: Kunigami, PS+, and Valentine event introduced.

title: February bug fixes
text: Fixed visual awakening freezes, ball respawn and King impact registration issues.

title: Yukimiya cooldown patch
text: Yukimiya cooldown changes reported for new servers; Lethal Touch set to 60s at the time.

title: Yukimiya and Hiori release
text: Yukimiya and Hiori styles and flows announced.

title: AI goalkeeper and Pro server
text: AI GK rework, Pro server, limited items and bug fixes.

title: Cutscene timer changes
text: Cutscene abilities stop the timer at this date, Gagamaru fixes and a limited cosmetic.

title: Reo and Nagi update
text: Reo style and flow, Nagi shooting ability and flow, Sae–Shidou chemistry and Isagi U20 goal added.

title: Ball reset vote
text: The /vrb command was introduced to reset a missing ball, requiring a large majority to agree.

title: Assist and style locking patch
text: Assist bug fixes, AI goalkeeper pass priority, style locking and rebirth fixes announced.

title: Winter map fixes
text: Winter lighting reduced, ball outline made black and winter quests fixed.

title: Winter event quests
text: Winter quests, currency and gacha introduced.

title: Winter update part one
text: Aiku style and flow added with winter content.

title: Goal and gifting fixes
text: Own goals disabled; ball-stuck-in-goal issue addressed; lucky spin gifting adjusted.

title: Gagamaru introduction
text: Gagamaru, lobby rankings room and two teams announced.

title: Shidou i-frames
text: I-frames announced for Shidou, shortly after the rework.

title: Shidou rework
text: Shidou rework announced, including ball-compatible abilities.

title: Shidou penalty box patch
text: Shidou abilities disabled inside the penalty box at that date.

title: Original Shidou tutorial
text: A tutorial described the original aerial Dragon Drive. Historical kit, superseded by later reworks.

title: Shidou and Nagi update
text: Shidou style added, Nagi buffs and awakening ability announced.

title: Early gameplay patch
text: Direct Shot fixed, tackle speed increased and duration reduced; Nagi aerial tackle issue addressed.
